families.context: What the old stretch ran on

access_closed.label: Closed to motor vehicles
access_closed.description: OSM marked the road closed to motor vehicles between the previous version and the change (or soon after).

sign_added.label: Restrictive sign added
sign_added.description: A no-entry or similar sign was mapped on the stretch in that window.

barrier_added.label: Barrier added
barrier_added.description: A gate, bollard or other barrier was mapped on the stretch in that window.

destination_only.label: Destination traffic only
destination_only.description: Motor access became destination-only in that window.

conditional.label: Seasonal / time restriction
conditional.description: A seasonal or time-based restriction was added in that window.

already_restricted.label: Already closed in OSM
already_restricted.description: The stretch was already mapped as closed to motor vehicles before the change; the route caught up with an existing closure.

closed_later.label: Closed after the change
closed_later.description: The road was mapped as closed only after the change (OSM often lags reality).

road_gone.label: No mapped road there now
road_gone.description: There is no OSM road along part of the stretch now (removed, never mapped, or rebuilt elsewhere). It is the main explanation only when it covers at least 25% of the stretch; shorter gaps are often drawing or mapping differences.

downgraded.label: Road downgraded
downgraded.description: OSM lowered the road class (e.g. track to path) in that window.

paved.label: Paved
paved.description: The road was mapped as paved in that window. It is the main explanation only when it covers at least 25% of the stretch.

to_offroad.label: Asphalt swapped for offroad
to_offroad.description: Rerouted onto a stretch with a clearly higher offroad share.

to_paved.label: Offroad swapped for asphalt
to_paved.description: Rerouted onto a stretch with a clearly lower offroad share.

realigned.label: Small realignment
realigned.description: The new line stays within 150 m of the old one: a correction or a parallel road.

shortcut.label: Shortcut
shortcut.description: The replacement is less than 70% of the old length.

detour.label: Longer detour
detour.description: The replacement is more than 150% of the old length.

big_rework.label: Large rework
big_rework.description: One change removed 25+ km and no single OSM finding covers 25% of it; findings along it are listed but are too local to explain it.

rework.label: Part of a large rework
rework.description: Changed in a version that rewrote at least 300 km or made 30+ changes.

busy_road.label: Was on busy roads
busy_road.description: At least 50% of the old stretch was on primary/secondary/tertiary roads.

built_up.label: Was on built-up streets
built_up.description: At least 50% of the old stretch was on residential or service streets.

no_road.label: Was not on a mapped road
no_road.description: At least 50% of the old stretch had no OSM road nearby (field, private land or a mapping gap).

none.label: No explanation found
none.description: None of the checks above matched.
